notes: אֹתָם → unto them: the marker takes the preposition the English predicate was gracious needs to reach its object (rule 16).
וַיְרַחֲמֵם → had compassion on them: light verb plus complement headed on compassion, with the supplied on belonging to the verb's unit (rule 44).
עַד־עָתָּה → as yet fused (rule 30); source head on עַתָּה chosen with עַד named as the competing syntactic head (rules 8, 23). Margin gloss read and set aside.
